caption: The drawing depicts a bouquet comprising several flowers and leaves arranged on a brown, textured background that has a grid or web-like pattern. The flowers are in various colors: large blossoms in red and cream with pink and maroon centers are predominant, accompanied by smaller flowers in shades of blue, light pink, and light purple. There are multiple small, circular red flower buds or berries interspersed among the leaves and flowers. The leaves are primarily green, some with dark blue or brown accents, and vary in size and shape, with some being spiky and others rounded. The bouquet appears dense, with overlapping elements, and covers most of the central area of the drawing. The artist's name, "Ruth M. Barnes," and a reference number are written at the bottom edge of the drawing.
title: Hooked Rug
